description: Java class providing utility functions for interacting with Android's X.509 certificates, including trust management, certificate validation, and system trust store handling.

classes.name: X509Util
classes.description: Main utility class for managing Android's X.509 certificates, trust managers, and trust store interactions.

classes.name: TrustStorageListener
classes.description: BroadcastReceiver that listens for keystore changes to invalidate caches and reload trust managers.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes trust managers and certificate factory if not already initialized.

methods.name: createTrustManager
methods.description: Creates a trust manager backed by a specified keystore or system default.

methods.name: addTestRootCertificate
methods.description: Adds a test root certificate to the test keystore and reloads trust manager.

methods.name: clearTestRootCertificates
methods.description: Clears all test root certificates from the test keystore.

methods.name: verifyServerCertificates
methods.description: Verifies a server's certificate chain against trust managers and returns verification result.
